title: MSME Classification
description: MSME classification is based on criteria notified by the Government of India.
relevance: Useful when determining whether a business falls within the MSME framework.
source: Government of India / Ministry of MSME

title: Udyam Registration
description: Eligible enterprises can use the Udyam Registration system for MSME registration.
relevance: Relevant for businesses seeking formal MSME registration.

title: Business Loan Due Diligence
description: Businesses should consider loan amount, interest rate, tenure, EMI, total repayment and cash flow before accepting credit.

title: Digital Financial Records
description: Maintaining organized records of sales, expenses, inventory and payments helps a business understand its financial position.
relevance: Useful for financial planning and business management.

title: GST Compliance
description: GST registration and compliance requirements depend on the nature, location and turnover of the business and applicable law.
relevance: Useful when assessing potential GST-related compliance requirements.
source: Government of India / GST official sources
